question: What is the name of the current Vice Chief of Army Staff who has been appointed the next Chief of Army Staff? (June 2024)
solution:
The correct answer is __**Upendra Dwivedi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Lt Gen Upendra Dwivedi** has been appointed the next Chief of the Army Staff, effective from June 30, 2024, succeeding **Manoj Pande.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Currently serving as the Vice Chief of the Army Staff, **Lt Gen Dwivedi's distinguished career includes commanding roles in various capacities, such as** Command of Regiment (18 Jammu & Kashmir Rifles), Brigade (26 Sector Assam Rifles), DIG of Assam Rifles (East), and 9 Corps.**
 
• He has been honored with the** Param Vishisht Seva Medal (PVSM), Ati Vishisht Seva Medal (AVSM), and has received three GOC-in-C Commendation Cards.**
 
• Lt Gen Dwivedi was commissioned into the** Infantry (Jammu & Kashmir Rifles) **of the Indian Army on December 15, 1984, and his career spans nearly four decades, during which he has served in a variety of Command, Staff, Instructional, and Foreign appointments.
 
• He is an alumnus of the **Sainik School Rewa, National Defence College, US Army War Colleg**e, and has undergone courses at the DSSC Wellington and Army War College, Mhow. He holds an M Phil in Defence & Management Studies and two Master's Degrees in Strategic Studies and Military Science.
 
• Lt Gen Dwivedi's tenure as the Vice Chief of Army Staff includes important appointments such as Director General Infantry and General Officer Commanding in Chief (Headquarter Northern Command) from 2022-2024
